units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:10">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> a woman said <he>לְזִיבָתִי</he> (v. <cite ref="G00262">preced.</cite>) which was interpreted as possibly meaning <he>זאב בא ליטול את בנה</he> a wolf had come near carrying off her son (and hence the thanks-offering); [differ. in <cite ref="Menachot 64b:11">Men. 64ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00115"><he>זוֹב</he></cite>].
